reviewMethod: Viewed all 42 new distinct full phone originals in eleven 1:1 sheets, each original 393x852, no cropping or scaling. Four first-failure distinct originals previously inspected separately; exact SHA reuse only. Reopened original expected reload-pending-split to confirm inherited text rendering.
scope: Regression approval of exact changed phone references only; no full design, all-content visibility, normal-motion or privacy-rule approval.
findings: Measured rail inset keeps resource values and next-tick visible above fleet hero. Existing compact campaign title ellipsis remains.

Formation, disband, cancellation, pending/reloaded split, accepted merge and recipient quantities remain readable in their intended views. Primary footer controls and focused Form fleet / Send fleet outlines fit.
Fleet/body scrollers intentionally show partial neighboring text and some inactive controls at edges; this does not claim simultaneous whole-content reading.
Route waypoint and accepted-departure views retain truthful quantities and disabled repeat actions; private peer views remain unchanged in meaning.
Reload-pending header raster appearance also exists in original expected image; no new typography defect inferred.
